newsitem.title: USA: Panaco to acquire Goldking for $43.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Panaco to acquire Goldking for $43.8 mln.

text.p: Panaco Inc said Thursday it has signed an agreement to acquire oil and gas exploration company Goldking Cos Inc for $43.8 million
The purchase price includes a combination of cash, notes, assumption of liabilities and 2.9 million shares of Panaco common stock.
Closing of the deal is scheduled for July 27.
Houston-based Goldking has engaged primarily in the exploration, acquisition, development and production of oil and gas along the Gulf Coast and in the state waters of Texas and Louisiana.

With the acquisition, Panaco will obtain proved reserves of more than 50 billion cubic feet equivalents at a price of about $0.70 per proved million cubic feet equivalent plus a sizeable and active portfolio of exploration prospects, Panaco said.

Goldking is expected to be operated as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Panaco, with Leonard Tallerine Jr remaining chairman and chief executive of Goldking. Panaco shares were unchanged at 4-1/2 Thursday.
